title: #songsforanewworld #chicagotheater #theoubique #jasonrobertbrown
transcript: last night I saw my first live in person musical since the shutdown and what's a better way to be reintroduced than through Jason Robert Brown's “Songs for a New World” This was my first time at Theo Ubique’s new location in evanston they moved from their scrappy storefront space in rogers park to this location a few years ago. the new space is great but if you don't have a car it's a hike and if you have a car parking seems to be a challenge now if you love theater you know the show I've cherished the cast recording since I was a teenager so it felt like visiting an old friend. the production features an amazing cast with killer vocals note the pronoun preferences in the bios I love that the direction is pretty straightforward but you don't really need gimmicks when you have such a talented cast and great material I found myself very moved by the final number, “hear my song” — and yes after 19 months I truly was ready to hear it. if you're in the area definitely check out this production.
